\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{হাঁপানি} (hā̃pāni)}{হাঁপানি (hā̃pāni)}]{\bn{হাঁপানি} (hā̃pāni) — asthma}

\label{lesson:BN-C474-hapani}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for an epidemic, then the Bengali for to be struck down.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{হাঁপানি}}
\textbf{\bn{হাঁপানি}} — \emph{hā̃pāni} — \textquotedblleft{}asthma\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{শীতে} \bn{দাদুর} \bn{হাঁপানি} \bn{বাড়ে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{shīte dādur hā̃pāni bāṛe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Grandfather's asthma gets worse in winter.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{হাঁপানি}} (\emph{hā̃pāni}) is the noun of \emph{hā̃pāno}, \textquotedblleft{}to pant\textquotedblright{}, which CDIAL lists for Bengali under a reconstructed root for panting (CDIAL 13973): the panting illness.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hā̃pāni}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{hā̃pāni}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{shīte dādur hā̃pāni bāṛe.} — Grandfather's asthma gets worse in winter.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for an epidemic, then the Bengali for to be struck down, then say \emph{hā̃pāni} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{হাঁপানি} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Asthma\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ডায়াবেটিস} (ḍāyābeṭis)}{ডায়াবেটিস (ḍāyābeṭis)}]{\bn{ডায়াবেটিস} (ḍāyābeṭis) — diabetes}

\label{lesson:BN-C474-dayabetis}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to be struck down, then the Bengali for asthma.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ডায়াবেটিস}}
\textbf{\bn{ডায়াবেটিস}} — \emph{ḍāyābeṭis} — \textquotedblleft{}diabetes\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{ডায়াবেটিসের} \bn{জন্য} \bn{দাদু} \bn{রসগোল্লা} \bn{খান} \bn{না।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{ḍāyābeṭiser jônyô dādu rôsôgollā khān nā.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Because of his diabetes my grandfather doesn't eat rasgullas.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ডায়াবেটিস}} (\emph{ḍāyābeṭis}) is borrowed from English \emph{diabetes}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{রক্তচাপ} (rôktôchāp)}{রক্তচাপ (rôktôchāp)}]{\bn{রক্তচাপ} (rôktôchāp) — blood pressure}

\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for asthma, then the Bengali for diabetes.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{রক্তচাপ}}

\textbf{\bn{রক্তচাপ}} (\emph{rôktôchāp}) puts \bn{রক্ত} (taught), blood, with \emph{chāp}, \textquotedblleft{}pressure\textquotedblright{}, from the family CDIAL lists for Bengali under a reconstructed \emph{capp}, \textquotedblleft{}press\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 4674).
